ProjectWeave request for the selected Task (data):
{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjccM8AAAABZjlFHA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IfzhDKTUI", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3If", "number": 73, "title": "Correct V30MZ direct JMP timing and destination alignment", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `264461a4077d7b99f4b58478365e4f2eb8195ed1`, `crates/ws-core/src/cpu.rs:744–758` executes E9 near, EA far and EB short JMP with the default one-clock execution charge and no odd-destination adjustment. Ordinary control flow therefore advances shared devices too little per jump, distorting polling, raster, timer and audio budgets. Commercial-title impact remains unmeasured.

## Expected outcome

Correct E9/EA/EB timing within the existing serialized CPU accounting while preserving destinations and architectural state. Include necessary native tests, an original cartridge probe, production-browser consumers and affected timing documentation.

Keep CALL, indirect JMP, Jcc/JCXZ timing, full prefetch and external-bus policy as separate work. In particular, E8 shares E9's dispatch arm and must retain its existing behavior.

## Context

The clean local checkout and inspected remote main match the baseline. The open Issue/PR collection is empty; all 72 closed entry titles were checked. [Issue #71](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/issues/71) and [PR #72](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/pull/72) explicitly deferred JMP.

The [NEC V30MZ manual](https://www.renesas.com/en/document/lbr/v30mztm-hardware-preliminary), Appendix A conditions/Note 5 and Table A-1, printed pp. 73 and 76, specifies BR near/short at four decoded execution clocks and BR far at seven, plus one clock for an odd destination. These direct forms perform no operand-memory transfer to subtract.

Preserve `Cpu::word` and `Bus::word_transfer` fetch consolidation. In accessible internal RAM, inferred unprefixed step totals are:

| Opcode | Even opcode IP, even target | Odd opcode IP, even target |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| EB | 6 | 6 |
| E9 | 7 | 6 |
| EA | 12 | 10 |

An odd target adds one. These totals combine documented execution costs with this emulator's actual fetch policy; they are not console measurements. Prefixes can change immediate-word alignment, so calculate their actual fetches rather than assuming a uniform additive total.

Correction record: old AI-authored assumption—default one-clock direct-JMP execution is adequate. Corrected requirement—instruction-specific execution costs, destination parity and actual fetch charges. Source—the primary table above. Rationale—these common instructions have distinct documented costs. Record further evidence-backed corrections with the old assumption, replacement, source and rationale, preserving relevant acceptance without an approval gate.

The inspected [WSTimingTest report](https://github.com/FluBBaOfWard/WSTimingTest/blob/025e606fc3b6615160ffdae485d992ffcad0c024/README.md) reports alignment effects on WonderSwan Color but qualifies aggregate harness/pipeline results. Its opcode-pattern workaround is unsuitable. Complete pipeline timing remains unresolved.

Existing LOOP/IRQ tests and consumers are present. [Saved #71 validation](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/264461a4077d7b99f4b58478365e4f2eb8195ed1/docs/issue-71-validation.md) reports 239 workspace tests and complete production Chromium suites passing, including negative controls and criterion-level review. This investigation inspected that evidence and ran no application builds or tests.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Record independent literal timing/state vectors before changing execution costs. Implement E9/EA/EB costs and destination parity; charge actual fetches/waits once, without reading the destination early or changing fetch consolidation. Keep interrupt entry and DMA reservations separate.
- [ ] Add native coverage for every form, both opcode and destination parities, forward/backward and zero relative displacements, displacement extremes, IP/immediate-fetch wrapping, far CS changes and 20-bit address wrapping. Assert exact CS/IP, preserved full FLAGS, registers, stack and memory. Cover mapped ROM banks with live A0 width/wait settings `00/04/08/0C`, accessible internal RAM, and existing segment/BUSLOCK prefix behavior through seven prefixes. Derive literal expectations independently of production timing helpers. Add discriminating preservation checks for shared-arm E8 CALL, indirect JMP, Jcc/JCXZ and existing REP rejection.
- [ ] Cover emulated Mono/Color/SwanCrystal model configurations: Mono mode `00`; Color and SwanCrystal modes `00/80/C0/E0`, including live transitions back to `00`. Through normal `Machine::run_frame`, prove corrected jumps cross selected raster/frame, timer and audio boundaries with exactly one instruction's clocks and no extra destination instruction. Preserve IRQ/TF priority, shadows, stacked continuation/IRET behavior, REP/HALT and separate GDMA/SDMA reservations and capability gates.
- [ ] Add a source-included original CC0 cartridge using repository fixture tooling, with independent native and production Chromium consumers. Measure absolute timing for all three JMP forms and both destination parities; check CPU-written execution counts and destination/continuation markers across every supported configuration and fresh restart. Invalidate stale saved completion. Document interval instructions, fetch alignment, overhead and timer quantization. Record an actual old-JMP failure in both consumers and corrected native/browser passes; relative parity differences alone are insufficient.
- [ ] Inspect and independently recalculate affected existing probe budgets and consumers. Preserve LOOP's absolute timing/count/CX/continuation checks and IRQ entry at 32/35 internal clocks, handler/application/countdown results `1024/0/0`, restart checks and rejection of the former IRQ charge. The current IRQ interval contains no direct JMP: retain its 61459/67603-clock and 240–241/264–265-tick expectations if measured bytes remain unchanged. Document any justified interval/layout change; do not widen tolerances or rewrite historical observations as new passes.
- [ ] Preserve three-model behavior, firmware-free startup, LCD/input/frame continuity, audio/PCM, GDMA/SDMA/Hyper Voice, SRAM/cartridge/internal EEPROM and RTC retention, browser save integrity, local data handling and ownership/provenance. Before merge, Coordinator runs `python3 fixtures/build.py --check`, `python3 demo/build.py --check`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo test --workspace --locked`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `git diff --check`. In `web`, run `npm run build:wasm`, `npm run build`, then complete `npm run test:browser` and `npm run test:compat` sequentially with `WS_PREVIEW_URL` targeting an explicit local production preview.
- [ ] Update timing documentation, fixture provenance and validation evidence with source/artifact identities, independent calculations, actual observations, failures, corrections and unperformed checks. Coordinator reviews the final diff and evidence against every criterion and resolves blocking findings before merge. All mandatory acceptance uses automated tooling; no human or console prerequisite is introduced.

## Optional validation

Additional lawfully available software timing experiments, another browser engine, console comparisons and human gameplay may provide supplementary evidence. None was performed during planning; none blocks this task. Commercial-game compatibility remains unestablished.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WonderSwan-family hardware goal.
Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance criteria when primary hardware
specifications establish the correction. Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.

This autonomous campaign has no human-approval gate. Mandatory acceptance uses
automated native and production-browser tests on the emulator's supported model
and mode configurations. Physical-console measurements and human gameplay are
optional evidence and must remain explicitly unperformed unless actually available.
Do not invent device identities, real-device results or a requirement for human
confirmation. Resolve technical errors with recorded evidence and automated checks
through the existing Coordinator workflow.
